runtime_tuning.scope: Opt this experiment process out of automatic Windows execution-speed throttling using the existing ABM process-tuning setting. No global power plan, model parameter, random seed, Q table or source change. Timing before and after is not a controlled performance comparison.

coverage.scope: Global and each observed size/policy-epoch group must pass in every validation world and pooled.

manifest_elapsed_seconds.interpretation: Archived per-run elapsed counters; not total CPU or whole-budget wall time.

limitations: Development-only baseline; no policy ranking or confirmatory seeds.
Fixed coverage gates are necessary diagnostics, not identification, Q convergence or empirical validation.
The 81-state representation omits complete capacity, project and market information; masks vary within keys.
Six paired worlds provide descriptive comparisons; no post-hoc significance gate or survivor filtering.
Private financing differences are accrued relative to the initial contract, not social welfare or lifetime profit.
Committed late actions and future audit liabilities are not fully settled within this horizon.
